entities.summary: Sergey Yevgenyevich Tsivilyov is a Russian statesman, politician, economist and former military officer who is currently serving as the Minister of Energy of Russia since 14 May 2024. He is a member of president Vladimir Putin's extended family by marriage to a daughter of his cousin, Deputy Minister of Defence Anna Tsivilyova.
